== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Path]] of the [[King’s Key]] is a specialized [[force Path]] created and exclusively practiced by [[Monarch]] [[Reigan Shen]], also known as the Emperor of the [[Rosegold continent]]. The [[Path]] is characterized by its command over spatial [[Authority|authority]], a power [[Shen]] acquired after bonding with a [[Sage’s Remnant]] during his youth. Its primary function involves the management of an extra-[[spatial vault]], which serves as a storage dimension for various items including weapons, techniques, and enemies. Beyond simple storage, the [[Path]] allows for the creation of portals and void spaces. [[Shen]] utilizes these spatial openings to deploy defenses, transport armies, or retrieve specific objects, such as spears of [[fire and destruction aura]]. The [[Path]]'s capabilities extend to the creation of complex devices, including a rumored [[Soulforge]] designed to act as the heart of an isolated world. While many believe its most efficient use is opening portals to spatially sealed treasures, the [[Path]]'s utility encompasses a wide range of spatial manipulations and defensive measures.}}
